title: Indefinite Integration
description: Class 12 IMO — Indefinite Integration: integration as the inverse of differentiation, standard integrals, integration by substitution and partial fractions, and by parts.

topics.title: Anti-derivatives and Standard Forms
topics.concept:
Integration reverses differentiation. An antiderivative (indefinite integral) of $f$ is a function $F$ with $F'(x)=f(x)$; we write $\displaystyle\int f(x)\,dx=F(x)+C$, where $C$ is the arbitrary constant of integration.

Standard integrals

$\displaystyle\int x^{n}\,dx=\frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1}+C\ (n\ne-1)$, $\ \displaystyle\int \frac1x\,dx=\ln|x|+C$, $\ \displaystyle\int e^{x}\,dx=e^{x}+C$, $\ \displaystyle\int \cos x\,dx=\sin x+C$, $\ \displaystyle\int \sec^2x\,dx=\tan x+C$.

Three core techniques

  • Substitution: if the integrand contains a function and its derivative, put $u=g(x)$, $du=g'(x)\,dx$.
  • Integration by parts: $\displaystyle\int u\,dv=uv-\int v\,du$. Choose $u$ by the ILATE order (Inverse, Log, Algebraic, Trig, Exponential).
  • Partial fractions: split a proper rational function into simpler fractions before integrating.

examples.solution: By parts with $u=x,\ dv=e^x dx$: $u=x,\ du=dx,\ v=e^x$. $\int xe^x dx=xe^x-\int e^x dx=xe^x-e^x+C=e^x(x-1)+C.$

recap: $\int f\,dx=F+C$ where $F'=f$; never omit the constant $C$.
Substitution targets "function and its derivative" patterns.
By parts: $\int u\,dv=uv-\int v\,du$, choose $u$ via ILATE.
Partial fractions break proper rational integrands into simple terms.

options: x cos x - sin x + C
x sin x + cos x + C
quiz.explanation: By parts: u = x, dv = sin x dx. du = dx, v = -cos x. ∫ u dv = uv - ∫ v du = -x cos x - ∫ (-cos x) dx = -x cos x + sin x + C.
This is a standard fundamental formula. The derivative of sin⁻¹ x is 1/√(1 - x²).

topics.title: Substitution and Partial Fractions
topics.concept:
Substitution sets u = g(x) so that du absorbs g′(x)dx, turning the integral into a standard form.

Partial fractions split a rational function into simpler fractions before integrating.
recap: Substitution: choose u whose derivative appears.

quiz.explanation: ∫dx/√(x² + a²) = ln|x + √(x² + a²)| + C or sinh⁻¹(x/a) + C. Both forms are equivalent.
Complete square: 3 + 2x - x² = 4 - (x-1)². Integral is ∫ dx / (2² - (x-1)²). Formula gives (1/(2*2)) log|(2+(x-1)) / (2-(x-1))| = (1/4) log|(x+1)/(3-x)| + C.

topics.title: Integration by Parts
topics.concept:
Integration by parts: ∫u dv = uv − ∫v du. Choose u by the ILATE order (Inverse, Log, Algebraic, Trig, Exponential).

It is ideal for products such as x·eˣ, x·sin x and ln x.

questions.q: If f(x) is an improper rational function like (x² + 1)/(x² - 5x + 6), what is the first step in integration?
questions.explanation: For improper rational functions (degree of numerator ≥ denominator), we must perform long division to express it as a polynomial plus a proper rational function.

questions.q: A manufacturing plant in Noida finds its marginal cost of producing x units is given by MC = 3x² - 2x + 5. If the fixed cost (cost at x=0) is ₹ 5000, find the total cost function C(x).
A Vande Bharat express train accelerating out of New Delhi station has an acceleration a(t) = 2 m/s². If its initial velocity is 10 m/s, what is its velocity function v(t)?
questions.explanation: v(t) = ∫ a(t) dt = ∫ 2 dt = 2t + C. v(0) = 10 implies C = 10.

questions.q: What is the process of finding a function whose derivative is given?
questions.explanation: Integration is the inverse process of differentiation. If d/dx f(x) = g(x), then the integral of g(x) is f(x).

questions.q: In the expression ∫ f(x) dx, what is the term 'f(x)' called?
questions.explanation: The function f(x) which is to be integrated is called the integrand.
Using identity sin²x = (1 − cos 2x)/2. ∫(1 − cos 2x)/2 dx = x/2 − (sin 2x)/4 + C.
Using partial fractions 1/(x-2) - 1/(x-1), integration yields log|x-2| - log|x-1| = log|(x-2)/(x-1)| + C.

questions.q: A startup's customer base grows at a rate of dN/dt = 100e^(0.1t) users per month. If they start with 1000 users at t=0, how many users will they have at time t?

questions.explanation: Standard form ∫ dx / √(x² - a²) = log|x + √(x² - a²)| + C. Here a = 2.
Divide by cos⁴ x to get sec² x dx / (tan⁴ x + 1). Put tan x = t. Then ∫ (t² + 1 - t²) / (t⁴ + 1) dt. Breaking and substituting u = t - 1/t gives the result.

questions.q: The ILATE rule for integration by parts prioritizes functions in which order?
options: Inverse trig, Log, Algebraic, Trig, Exponential
Inverse trig, Log, Algebraic, Trig, Exponential (correct spelling)
Log, Inverse trig, Algebraic, Trig, Exponential
Algebraic, Trig, Exponential, Log, Inverse trig
questions.explanation: ILATE stands for Inverse trigonometric, Logarithmic, Algebraic, Trigonometric, Exponential — this is the priority order for choosing the first function u.
cos²x = (1 + cos 2x)/2. Integral = ∫(1/2)dx + (1/2)∫cos 2x dx = x/2 + (sin 2x)/4 + C.

questions.q: Evaluate: ∫ (eˣ (1 + x log x) / x) dx
questions.explanation: Rewriting as ∫ eˣ (1/x + log x) dx. This matches ∫ eˣ (f'(x) + f(x)) dx where f(x) = log x. Result is eˣ f(x) = eˣ log x + C.
